description: The ``AWS::ApiGateway::VpcLink`` resource creates an API Gateway VPC link for a REST API to access resources in an Amazon Virtual Private Cloud (VPC). For more information, see [vpclink:create](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/api/API_CreateVpcLink.html) in the ``Amazon API Gateway REST API Reference``.. Source:- https://github.com/aws-cloudformation/aws-cloudformation-rpdk.git
